basics.name: Carmina Nascimento
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer | Backend & Distributed Systems | System Design | Cloud | Event-Driven Architecture
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer focused on backend engineering, system design and distributed systems. I build and evolve software systems that deal with complex requirements, scale, performance and long-term maintainability — from modernizing legacy platforms to designing backend services and asynchronous, event-driven solutions. My experience spans Kotlin, Java, Spring Boot, Python, .NET, GCP, relational and NoSQL databases, as well as API design, performance optimization, cloud services and software architecture. At Instituto de Pesquisas ELDORADO, I work across the software lifecycle, from architecture and backend development to product delivery and technical problem solving. I have also contributed to developer productivity through AI-assisted engineering workflows and internal tools. Earlier in my career, I spent almost seven years at Sidia, working on Samsung-related software platforms and progressively moving from QA into software engineering. This gave me a strong perspective on software quality, testing, development, architecture and the evolution of complex legacy systems. I also enjoy mentoring engineers, reviewing code and helping teams turn ambiguous problems into maintainable technical solutions. Areas of interest: Backend Engineering · Distributed Systems · System Design · Software Architecture · Cloud Computing · Event-Driven Systems · Performance · AI-assisted Software Engineering

work.name: Instituto de Pesquisas Eldorado
highlights: Design, develop, and maintain cloud-native backend services using Kotlin, Java, Spring Boot, Python (Flask), MySQL, and Google Cloud Platform, supporting enterprise-scale applications.
Design RESTful APIs and event-driven integrations using Google Cloud Pub/Sub and asynchronous messaging, contributing to scalable and reliable distributed systems.
Participate in system architecture and technical decisions across monolithic and distributed environments, focusing on scalability, maintainability, performance, and long-term system evolution.
Optimize backend processing and complex database queries.

Design and develop LLM-powered developer productivity tools, including AI- assisted workflows for analyzing Jira change requests, identifying impacted components, and generating or updating unit tests based on source code changes.

Drive engineering practices that improve knowledge sharing and maintainability, authoring technical documents covering architecture, database schemas, engineering decisions, onboarding, and development workflows.
Mentor trainees and interns, supporting their technical development and contributing to the conversion of two interns into full-time engineers.
Collaborate closely with Product Management and platform users to translate business and user needs into technical requirements and product improvements.
Contribute to technical publications based on software engineering projects, connecting practical engineering work with applied research.

work.name: Sidia Instituto de Ciência e Tecnologia
highlights: Progressed from Quality Assurance to Full Stack Engineering, taking on increasing ownership of enterprise software, backend systems, architecture, and technical leadership across multiple Samsung initiatives.

Designed and developed a centralized quality management platform that replaced spreadsheet-based workflows for Samsung’s Latin America QA hub, enabling QA engineers to manage concurrent testing projects, execution status, and validation results through a web application that remains in active use.
Designed and maintained enterprise applications and RESTful backend services using Java, C#, .NET, WPF, JavaScript, Angular, MySQL, and REST APIs, supporting Samsung’s Quality Assurance organization.
Led the modernization of legacy backend services by migrating APIs to .NET 5 and refactoring application architecture to improve maintainability, reliability, and long-term evolution.
Modernized a large legacy analytics platform by moving business logic from the frontend to the backend, reducing technical debt while continuing to deliver new functionality.

Optimized backend services and database operations powering near real- time dashboards, charts, maps, and reporting for Samsung device quality monitoring, processing data from thousands of devices daily.

Assumed technical leadership of a critical project following the departure of the technical lead, coordinating two software engineering interns, leading technical discussions, collaborating with Samsung stakeholders, and successfully delivering the remaining project scope.

Established automated quality gates through GitLab CI pipelines and developed comprehensive unit tests and developer tooling that provided real- time code coverage feedback, improving software quality and preventing regressions.
Participated in architecture discussions, code reviews, and large-scale refactoring initiatives, driving improvements in system maintainability, performance, and development practices.
